system.description:
SHAMAN

Another spirit has entered the relationship. Whether your original guide approves is a different question.
Select a second Spirit Guide. You gain its Specialist Skill and Spirit Boon.
Whenever you activate Manifest Spirit, choose which of your two Spirit Guides manifests. You gain only that guide's Manifestation for the duration.
Your original guide remains your primary guide for any effect requiring one.

Prerequisites Level 10

Use to choose your second Spirit Guide: it arrives as an ability with its specialist skill and Spirit Boon; Manifest Spirit then asks which guide manifests.
